title: Does the Deal Land in H1 for President's Club?
scenario_text: Ionian Cloud's sales-compensation team is finalizing first-half President's Club qualification and must decide which half a large deal belongs to. The rep, Priya S., needs $1,200,000 in closed bookings across H1 (ending 2026-06-30) to qualify, and her other H1 deals total $900,000. The deal in question, OPP-4477 with customer 'Delacroix Retail,' is worth $350,000 in bookings, which alone would push her over the threshold. Ionian's booking policy is explicit: 'A deal is booked in the period in which the signed order form reaches fully-executed status, defined as the DocuSign completion timestamp when the last required signature is applied. Verbal commitments, redlined drafts, and internal approvals do not book a deal; only the fully-executed timestamp controls the period.' The audit trail shows: the customer gave verbal commitment on a call dated 2026-06-24; the redlined order form was approved by deal desk on 2026-06-27; the customer's authorized signer applied the final DocuSign signature, moving the envelope to Completed, at 2026-07-02 09:15. The rep's manager, eager to credit H1, argues the deal was 'effectively done' at the verbal commit on 2026-06-24. The compensation analyst must apply the booking policy strictly and decide whether OPP-4477 books in H1 (on or before 2026-06-30) and therefore whether Priya S. reaches the $1,200,000 H1 President's Club threshold.
question: Does OPP-4477 book in H1, and does Priya S. reach the H1 President's Club threshold?
changed_fact: The DocuSign completion timestamp moves from 2026-06-29 (before the 2026-06-30 end-of-H1 cutoff) to 2026-07-02 (after it). In the base the deal closes in H1; in the variant it closes in H2, so the rep's H1 President's Club threshold is or is not reached.
choices: Yes; OPP-4477 books in H1 because the DocuSign envelope reached Completed on 2026-06-29, so her H1 bookings total $1,250,000 and she qualifies.
No; OPP-4477 books in H2 because the envelope did not reach Completed until after 2026-06-30, so her H1 bookings stay at $900,000 and she does not qualify.
Yes; OPP-4477 books in H1 because the verbal commitment occurred on 2026-06-24, regardless of when the envelope was signed.
No; because the redline was still being negotiated in late June, the deal cannot be booked in either half until the next fiscal year.
